About Farmward Cooperative

Your Trusted Ag Partner

Farmward Cooperative proudly serves Southern Minnesota, offering a full range of ag services. Headquartered in Morgan, MN, Farmward empowers growers through innovation, strong community ties, and exceptional support. Since 2017, Farmward and its subsidiaries AgQuest Financial Services and Northland Capital have been dedicated to leveraging technology to tackle challenges and create new opportunities for growers.
